title: Kyiv: 142 drones intercepted
description: 'As much harm as possible' — 5 killed, 63 injured as Russia resumes mass attacks across Ukraine As of 8:30 a.m., with the attack still ongoing, air defenses had downed or suppressed two ballistic missiles, 31 cruise missiles, and 142 drones.
